name: Wind Release: Eye of the Storm

system.description:
You Create a powerful twisting cyclone of wind that seals yourself and all creatures in this jutsu’s radius off from other creatures and effects from outside this jutsu’s radius.

Creatures outside this jutsu’s radius cannot see into the opaque wall of twisting wind. A creature with Chakra sight when looking at the wall only sees a wall of chakra and cannot make out anything within.

If a creature attempts to pass through the wall, they must make a Strength saving throw. On a successful save they pass through the wall. On a failed save they take 6d8 wind damage and are pushed back to the centermost space. This jutsu’s walls, collectively share 200 hit points, with resistance to lightning damage, and vulnerability to Fire damage.

While inside this jutsu’s radius, electricity cannot be generated and Jutsu with the Lightning release keyword cannot be cast.

If the wall takes cold damage from a Jutsu with the water release keyword, the walls becomes wreathed in water, gaining resistance to Fire damage.
